C-5 Hydraulic Valve Repair 

The Air Force has a requirement for depot-level repair for various C-5 mechanical components. The three items listed below are to be included in this effort: 

60 GPM Hydraulic Relief Cartridge Valve -                NSN: 1650001059655      PN: 1636
Temperature Compensated Pressure Regulator -    NSN: 1650002418862      PN: 854550-5-1
20 GPM Hydraulic Dual Shuttle Valve -                     NSN: 4820001614098      PN: 5046-1

This acquisition will be a 100% Small Business Set Aside. This repair effort will utilize a Requirements Type Contract. The Contract period of performance will be five (5) years. It will consist of a one (1) year basic period and four (4) one (1) year ordering periods. The Best Estimated Quantities for each ordering period are listed below.

It is anticipated the RFP will be released in June 2026. Interested parties MUST be registered in the Joint Certification Program and approved to view Export Control, and shall submit evidence of their certification in order to obtain the associated data packages. Please do not submit this information prior to release of the Request for Proposal (RFP). All responsible sources may submit a bid, proposal, or quotation which shall be considered by the agency. Offerors are encouraged to register on the site to receive notifications regarding the solicitation and all amendments/revisions.
